# Odoo 19 -> 20 traps (validator catalogue)

Every rule below is checked by `odoo_validate` and the PostToolUse hook. `Fixed by` names the Odoo `upgrade_code` script that rewrites it automatically (`odoo_upgrade_code`). Suppress a deliberate case with a comment containing `odoo20-ignore: RULE_ID` on that line.

## Security (ir.access)

| Rule | Sev. | Files | Trap | Odoo 20 way | Fixed by | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SEC001 | error | js, py, xml | Models ir.model.access and ir.rule no longer exist | Use the single `ir.access` model: rows with a group are permissions (OR-ed), rows without a group are restrictions (AND-ed); `operation` is a c-r-u-d subset; `domain` replaces rule domains. | 19.4-00-ir-access | `odoo/addons/base/models/ir_access.py` |
| SEC002 | error | csv | ir.model.access.csv is not loaded by Odoo 20 | Convert to `security/ir.access.csv` with header `id,name,model_id,group_id/id,operation,domain` (model_id = technical model name such as `sale.order`; operation such as `crud`, `cru`, `r`). List it last in the manifest `data`. | 19.4-00-ir-access | `odoo/upgrade_code/19.4-00-ir-access.py` |
| SEC003 | error | py | check_access_rights / check_access_rule were removed | Use `records.check_access('read'\|'write'\|'create'\|'unlink')` (raises) or `has_access(op)` (bool); `_filtered_access(op)` filters a recordset. |  | `odoo/orm/models.py` |
| SEC004 | error | py | _filter_access_rules(_python) was removed | Use `records._filtered_access(operation)`. |  | `odoo/orm/models.py` |
| SEC005 | warning | py | Overriding _check_access is deprecated since 20.0 | Override `_access_domain(self, operation) -> Domain` instead (example: addons/mail/models/mail_mail.py). |  | `odoo/orm/models.py` |
| SEC006 | warning | py | res.groups fields model_access / rule_groups were replaced | Use `access_ids` (One2many to ir.access) on res.groups. |  | `odoo/addons/base/models/res_groups.py` |

| ORM020 | error | py, xml | get_formview_action was renamed | Use `get_record_default_action()`. |  | `odoo/addons/base/models/ir_ui_view.py` |

(Ignore if this is your own model's field.) |  | `odoo/addons/base/models/res_partner_bank.py` |

## Cross-module checks (odoo_validate, index-backed)

| Rule | Meaning |
|---|---|
| MAN100-MAN108 | manifest: unparsable, unknown depends, missing data file, ir.access not last, no license, foreign major version (installable=False), data file never loaded, asset glob matches nothing, no author |
| PYI001 | python file/package never imported |
| PYM001 / PYM002 | `_inherit` target or relational comodel not defined in the dependencies |
| VIEW001-VIEW004 | view model unknown, field not on model, button calls a private or missing method |
| SEC101-SEC106 | ir.access: invalid operation, model name/xmlid misuse, bad domain, c/u/d for portal/public/everyone, model without any permission row (default deny) |
| REF001-REF003 | xmlid from a module that is not a dependency, unknown module, xmlid not found |
| JSI001-JSI003 | JS import does not resolve, comes from a non-dependency, imports a name the module does not export |
| RNG001 / RNG002 | data file rejected by odoo/import_xml.rng, primary view rejected by base/rng/<type>_view.rng |
